articles.title: DEMOCRATIC SWEEP OF CONGRESS FORCES CRYPTO INDUSTRY TO RETHINK STRATEGY
articles.summary: Democrats took both chambers, and Stand With Crypto counts 19 pro-crypto senators and 226 House members elected against 8 and 106 anti-crypto. Sherrod Brown beat Jon Husted in Ohio despite more than $60M in crypto PAC spending against him. TD Cowen says the Clarity Act is unlikely to advance for two years and expects investigations into World Liberty Financial. Fairshake spent $154.5M this cycle, and one industry source said the money would have been better spent on direct lobbying. Industry voices stress that crypto is bipartisan, and focus is expected to shift to taxes and security after the Binance hack.

articles.title: CIRCLE Q3 2026: $865M REVENUE, 85% EBITDA BEAT, BINANCE $100M INVESTMENT
articles.summary: Circle reported Q3 2026 revenue of $864.9M and adjusted EBITDA of $317M, beating consensus by 85% as USDC minting reached $104B against an $82.45B estimate. Binance committed a $100M equity investment and expanded its USDC partnership, while Circle agreed to acquire Tazapay to add $25B+ in annualized payment volume across 100+ markets. Samsung Wallet and Visa Direct deployments extended USDC access to bank accounts in 60+ countries and payout rails across 180+ countries. USDC market share slipped 1.83 percentage points year-over-year to 27%, and Circle cut ~5% of staff as reserve income (about 75% of revenue) faces pressure from falling rates.

articles.title: POWER PERPS ON HYPERLIQUID
articles.summary: Paragon introduced Power Perps on Hyperliquid, a family of perpetual contracts that track an asset's price raised to a power, with HYPE² as the first instrument delivering 4x exposure when the underlying doubles. The structure carries no strikes or expiry dates, consolidating trader interest into a single persistent order book per underlying rather than fragmenting liquidity across an options chain as conventional instruments do. Hyperliquid's portfolio margin allows cross-margining of spot, linear perps, and Power Perps in one account, while market makers hedging delta in existing spot and perp books add order flow that tightens Power Perp spreads. Paragon frames these contracts as composable building blocks: a squared perp paired with a short linear approximates a straddle, while the reverse combination, short power and long linear, earns funding when the market trades sideways.

articles.title: BLAST L2 SHUTS DOWN, OPENS 12-MONTH ASSET RECOVERY WINDOW
articles.summary: Blast L2, launched in early 2024 with native yield on deposited ETH and stablecoins and peak TVL in the billions, has shut down. Users with assets in L2 wallets, pending withdrawals, or Blast Mobile can recover ETH and USD via the team's recovery site through November 4, 2027. Unclaimed funds after that date may be unrecoverable. The closure ends one of 2024's prominent yield-bearing L2 experiments, where protocol-level auto-yield on deposits served as the primary TVL acquisition mechanism rather than external incentive programs.

articles.title: PAYMENTS ARE THE NEW ADS
articles.summary: Agentic commerce has exposed a structural gap in payments: AI shopping agents have four paths to pay, each with material friction, and broken flows have deterred 60% of UK adults from trusting agent purchases after a single failure. Stripe's Instinct Balance, a prefunded stablecoin wallet, sidesteps bank authentication friction and earns Stripe ~$1.95 per $100 spent compared to ~$0.40 on virtual cards, a 4x unit-economics advantage over the network-token path. Banks have a counter through agent-authenticated network tokens modeled on Apple Pay's 2014 liability deal, but Chase has not joined any major agent platform, leaving the token infrastructure incomplete. If stablecoin balances capture agentic spend before banks resolve token liability, those funds exit bank deposits for good, shifting the customer-ownership fight from card rails to stablecoin custodians.

articles.title: REUSABLE NETWORKS: WHY AI MAKES CRYPTO'S NETWORK EFFECTS VALUABLE
articles.summary: As AI drives software production costs toward zero, value migrates from applications to the networks they compose with: protocol liquidity, on-chain identity graphs, reputation systems, and settlement rails. AI can clone interfaces and regenerate code in minutes, but it cannot reproduce the provenance of an NFT, the liquidity depth of Uniswap, or the trust accumulated in USDC. This reframes crypto's composability thesis: when any application becomes a commodity, the scarce asset is access to the shared state layer underneath. Blockchains were designed as canonical internet-layer state, and in a world where agents need reliable, permissionless coordination infrastructure, that original premise becomes a stronger value proposition.

articles.title: NO ONE NEEDS BLOCKCHAIN
articles.summary: The CFTC's approval of single-stock perpetual futures, matched by Kalshi's same-day launch, illustrates a structural trend: 2026's crypto growth concentrated in businesses treating blockchain as financial rails, while onchain-native DeFi lagged. Kalshi's architecture is representative, with orders matched in a proprietary engine and clearing running through a registered DCO, leaving blockchain to handle only stablecoin deposits/withdrawals and tokenized positions on Solana. The two growth clusters, speculation-driven (prediction markets, perps, and memecoins) and TradFi-connected (stablecoins, RWAs, and vaults), share the same pattern: platforms owning user relationships capture revenue, and blockchain captures infrastructure fees. This creates a value capture problem for the ecosystem, which risks commoditization unless more businesses emerge where blockchain is indispensable to core logic rather than settlement infrastructure.

articles.title: WHY STRIPE WILL LOSE AGENTIC PAYMENTS
articles.summary: Stripe's two agentic payment methods, Shared Payment Tokens (zero merchant adoption and opposed by card networks) and issued virtual cards (single-auth limits, no rewards, and identity mismatches), both fail to satisfy networks and end users, while Shopify now carries Visa, Mastercard, Amex, and Discover agent tokens natively through Shop Pay without routing credentials through Stripe. The structural argument is that the industry will skip Stripe's intermediary layer entirely, moving from raw PANs directly to native agent token standards like VIC and AgentPay, which makes Stripe's existing network effects irrelevant. Startups that build UX around native agent token flows rather than Stripe credentials are positioned to capture agentic commerce distribution as credential ownership shifts to the card networks themselves.

articles.title: AMERICAN BITCOIN SWINGS TO A $126 MILLION Q3 PROFIT ON DIGITAL ASSET GAINS
articles.summary: Eric Trump's miner reported $126M net income, reversing a $57.2M Q2 loss, driven by a $197.3M gain on digital assets.

articles.title: ARKANSAS SUES KALSHI, ALLEGING ILLEGAL GAMBLING AND MENTAL HEALTH HARMS
articles.summary: Arkansas AG Tim Griffin filed suit alleging Kalshi runs an illegal gambling platform, citing risks like excessive wagering, financial losses, and depression.

articles.title: PAYMAN LAUNCHES GATEWAY SO BANKS CAN RUN THEIR OWN AI AGENT TO DEAL WITH CUSTOMERS' AGENTS
articles.summary: Payman Gateway gives a bank its own AI agent to answer requests from agents customers use, such as Muse or Instinct.
